headline: Nucor Corporation (NUE) Strengthened from Trade Policy Tailwinds
summary: Diamond Hill Capital, a First Eagle Investment Management company, issued its Q2 2026 investor letter for its “Large Cap Strategy”. A copy of the letter is available to download here. The Strategy returned 3.42% net of fees, trailing the Russell 1000 Value Index’s 13.87% gain.
